description: Aggregate New York public authority borrowing by year and by authority class — total par issued, how much was new money versus refunding, and the most active issuers. Answers "how much did New York authorities borrow in 2024", "which New York issuers borrow the most", "how much of this is refinancing". Primary-market issuance only.

authority_class.description: Restrict to one class: state | local | ida | ldc. Omit for all four.

top.description: How many top issuers to return (default 15).
